source_title: SD Motor Carrier Handbook Ch. 5-6 (Size Regs & Permits); SDCL 32-22
verify_reasons: South Dakota publishes no formal 'superload' class; the manual-review triggers encoded here (gross over 200,000 lbs, height over 16', overweight combined with width over 12') are from third-party cross-references and were not found verbatim on the official handbook pages — confirm with SDHP/SDDOT.
No height/pole-car or police-escort dimensional trigger was found on the official handbook; those escort fields are omitted pending confirmation.

Legal gross of 80,000 lbs is the standard federal ceiling but was not read from South Dakota's exact official weight page (the official length 'Table 7' is image-based and unreadable, and the SD Legislature/Justia statute pages were 403-blocked).

superload_thresholds.note: South Dakota does not use the term 'superload'. Loads enter SDDOT + Highway Patrol manual review at gross over 200,000 lbs, height over 16', or overweight combined with width over 12' (third-party cross-reference; not confirmed verbatim on the official handbook). Where a value is null the handler flags very large dimensions for manual verification.

width.note: 1 escort over 16' wide on the Interstate, or over 20' wide on the State Highway System (SD Motor Carrier Handbook Ch. 6); front on undivided highways, rear on divided; additional escorts if the load extends over 2' into an adjacent lane

length.note: UNOFFICIAL cross-ref: ~1 escort over 130' long; not found verbatim in the official handbook (official length table is image-based)

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip OS/OW permit = $25 per permit. Overweight adds $0.02 per ton-mile for the excess weight over legal. Emergency single-trip $25.
single_trip.note: Single-trip permits also sold in books of ten; LCV permits $100 per book of ten.

annual.note: Annual/extended-period permit $60 (most categories, including over-80,000-lb Interstate); Longer Combination Vehicle $100 per book of ten (SD Motor Carrier Handbook Ch. 6).

movement_restrictions: Interstate: night movement prohibited if an escort is required, or the load is over 10' wide, over 14'6" high, or a single unit over 45' long (SD Motor Carrier Handbook Ch. 6)
Non-Interstate highways: no night movement of oversize loads except specified emergency/defense scenarios; overweight-only vehicles may move at night if no escort is required
Daylight window (1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset, including weekends) per third-party cross-reference
notes: Legal width 8'6" (102"), height 14'0" (exceptions: baled hay 15', some farm/fire equipment on non-Interstate), semitrailer 53' in a truck-tractor+semitrailer combination (SDCL 32-22-8.1), gross 80,000 lbs.

Width/height legal limits, fees and movement rules confirmed from the official SD Motor Carrier Handbook (sdtruckinfo.sd.gov); superload triggers, length/height/police escort thresholds remain cross-referenced pending official confirmation.
